body:
The authorized in-place six-way performance lane continues alongside release preparation. Two-phase workflow correction #237 is merged at `7945f956b428359928908a9f42e36417b113dafd`; read-only preparation run [38147141244](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/actions/runs/38147141244) is active. **PUBLICATION HOLD remains: no tag, release, or publisher dispatch. Performance is not a technical release gate.**

New independent evidence: one guarded Go 1.26.9 standard-library gzip analogue completed with numeric outer/build/metadata/runtime exit **0**, **300 verified calls**, **20 objects** (102,457,064 logical / 45,517,701 stored bytes), and **30 phase events**. Root checked actual original stored/logical bytes, descriptor/mode/mtime/index/manifest closure, all rows/schedules, binary/compiler metadata and resource limits. All 20 canonical frame digests equal the actual original gzip objects. Median weighted throughput: legacy decode **136.609 MiB/s**, BestSpeed encode **95.004 MiB/s**, BestSpeed decode **134.039 MiB/s**. Total guarded compile plus runtime was 47.227 s; sampled runtime process-tree RSS peaked at 165,658,624 bytes. These are memory-backed codec observations, **not direct RCC materialization, a controlled Go-versus-zstd comparison, an Actions result, or a performance improvement**. Earlier external-Python wrapper failure remains recorded; no timed retry rebounded its status.

Exact experimental binary: `a25beb9e343e6d616e86dcdbd28a820bd1f5a6d53286637fe5c4debb8b433f06`; raw results: `4a8e7954b26265c131d35d3365a3c665643a06b6579c52b33fdc2ffd1ef06ade`. Raw execution, rejected/unexecuted plan revisions, independent verification and scoped limitations are [durable at a98cc21](https://github.com/joshyorko/rcc/tree/a98cc21ab6fd803a78156dfed5bd69dadd608315/developer/swarm/20261011/continuation-1436). All 72 newly pushed files were independently fetched and byte/hash verified; all 1,181 older entries remain unchanged.

Compression, packfiles, prewarming/reuse, reflinks/clonefile, lazy/FUSE, and compressed-image/COW investigations remain preserved. No default behavior or format changed and no winner was selected. Actions newer-version restriction repair is explicitly authorized for its existing owners; coordination is at [Actions #133](https://github.com/joshyorko/actions/issues/133#issuecomment-6109883396). Latest owner-read source still gates exact RCC3 and no repaired path/controller/fixture admission has arrived. Actual original three-case Actions receipt was independently accepted only for its original source and stable3 contract. Real newer-version six-workload testing remains pending that admission and adequate guarded cold-workload disk space; publication is not a prerequisite.
